youtube_title: Check Your PF Balance With One Missed Call. Rules You Didn't Know #24 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #24. No app, no password, no OTP: give a missed call to 9966044425 from the mobile number registered with your UAN. The call cuts by itself, it's free, and an SMS comes back with your PF balance and last contribution.
Condition: your UAN must have KYC linked (Aadhaar, bank account or PAN).
SMS option: send EPFOHO UAN to 7738299899.
Source: EPFO member passbook portal (passbook.epfindia.gov.in).
